about.desc: Jerossa is a B2B marketplace dedicated to the exceptional raw materials of Madagascar and Mauritius. We connect local producers with international buyers with transparency and quality.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2015, Jerossa was born from a shared passion for the exceptional raw materials of Madagascar and Mauritius. What started as a small fair-trade project has grown into a leading B2B marketplace, connecting more than 200 local producers with buyers around the world.
about.storyP2: Our commitment to quality, transparency and fair trade guides every action we take. We believe that every product tells a story — that of its producers, its terroir and its ancestral craft.
about.title: About Jerossa
about.value.excellenceDesc: Our commitment to excellence is reflected in every product we put at your disposal.
about.value.fairDesc: We guarantee fair compensation for our producers and transparent conditions for everyone.
about.value.qualityDesc: We select only the best raw materials, verified and certified by our experts.

faq.a1: Delivery times vary depending on your location. For Madagascar, allow 2 to 5 business days. For Mauritius and international, allow 5 to 10 business days via our certified logistics partners.
faq.a2: We accept bank cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers as well as local mobile money solutions (MVola, Orange Money, Airtel Money for Madagascar; Juice/MauCas for Mauritius).
faq.a3: To become a seller, click on "Become a seller" in the menu, fill in the form with your company details and submit your documents. Our team will review your application within 48 hours.
faq.a4: Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email with a tracking number. You can also track your order from the "My orders" section of your account.
faq.a5: Some of our products are certified organic. Each product page shows the certifications available. We work with producers who follow strict quality standards.
faq.a6: You can contact us at any time via our online contact form or by direct messaging. Our support team answers your questions from Monday to Friday.

home.faq.1.a: Jerossa connects producers and suppliers from Madagascar and Mauritius with buyers and businesses. Browse the product catalogue, compare offers and contact the seller directly.
home.faq.1.q: How does the Jerossa platform work?
home.faq.2.a: Yes. Create your account, then click "Publish an offer" to list a product (vanilla, spices, crafts…). Your offer becomes visible to buyers in both territories.
home.faq.3.a: You can display prices in Ariary (MGA), Mauritian Rupee (MUR) or Euro (EUR) using the currency selector. Amounts are indicative based on the current conversion rate.
home.faq.3.q: What currencies are prices displayed in?
home.faq.4.a: Trust badges like "Verified supplier" or "Controlled product" signal verified offers. The profile and review verification system will gradually support the platform's development.
home.faq.5.a: The platform is preparing to integrate secure payments (cards, bank transfer, mobile money). Initially, transactions are conducted transparently between parties, with messaging and Jerossa support.
home.faq.5.q: What payment methods do you accept?

legal.privacy.contactText: For any question regarding this policy, contact us at privacy@jerosa.mg.
legal.privacy.dataText: We collect the following data: identification information (name, email, phone), order data (delivery addresses, purchase history), and technical data (IP address, browser, pages visited).
legal.privacy.introText: Jerossa Trading Ltd. is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy describes how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our marketplace.
legal.privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@jerosa.mg.
legal.privacy.storageText: Your data is stored securely and is only accessible to our authorised staff. We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.usageText: Your data is used to process your orders, improve our services, personalise your experience and send you commercial communications with your consent.
legal.terms.deliveryText: Jerossa undertakes to ship products as soon as possible. Delivery times are indicative and do not constitute a guaranteed delivery period. Risk passes to the buyer upon delivery.
legal.terms.ipText: All site content (texts, images, logos, trademarks, graphics) is the exclusive property of Jerossa Trading Ltd. Any reproduction is prohibited without prior authorisation.
legal.terms.objetText: These general terms and conditions of sale govern the relationship between Jerossa Trading Ltd. and any buyer using the Jerossa marketplace to purchase raw materials.
legal.terms.ordersText: Any order placed on Jerossa implies unreserved acceptance of these terms. Jerossa reserves the right to refuse or cancel any order deemed abnormal or fraudulent.
legal.terms.priceText: Prices shown are in euros and exclude tax unless otherwise stated. Payment must be made at the time of ordering. Jerossa accepts bank cards, mobile payment and bank transfers.
legal.terms.returnsText: Returns are accepted within 30 days of receipt. Products must be returned in their original condition. Refunds are processed within 14 days of receiving the return.
